versions.changelog: Static images deliver as SVG by default; PNG rendering runs only when explicitly requested. Engine comparison notes documented for renderer selection.
Rendering robustness & speed: parallel frame rendering, --bg now works on all engines incl. GIF matte, Chrome headless hang fixed with file-watch + reap, Windows MP4 symlink fallback.
Initial public release — v1.1.0. SVG authoring → PNG/GIF/APNG/WebP/MP4 export, cross-platform, zero-deps.
